title: MarkdownViewer's specification has drifted from the component in four places
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists

evidence.verified: Each of the four claims was checked against the source before rewriting. `MarkdownViewer.tsx:57`, `:60` and `:61` declare the three props the table omitted. `:684` gates the outline on `outline && !outlineCollapsed`, so it unmounts, while `:777` renders the minimap whenever `minimap` is set with `width: 0` when collapsed and `:764` renders its rail alongside. `:258` returns the empty block before any article. `npm run check` exits 0.

details:
- The props table at `components/MarkdownViewer.md:31` lists fifteen props and omits three the component accepts: `onImageSrc`, `onHeadingNavigate` and `initialHeading`, declared at `src/components/MarkdownViewer.tsx:57`, `:60` and `:61`. Three shipped capabilities are invisible to a reader.
- `:106` says a pane and its rail are never in the DOM together. `MarkdownViewer.tsx:777` renders the minimap whenever `minimap` is set, styled to zero width, while `:764` renders the rail beside it when collapsed.
- `:91` describes the outline collapsing by transitioning its width to zero. `MarkdownViewer.tsx:684` unmounts it instead. The width transition it describes is what the minimap does, so the two descriptions are swapped.
- `:185` says empty content renders an empty article. `MarkdownViewer.tsx:258` returns an empty-state block before any article, which the same document describes correctly at `:55`.

The second one matters most. The specification invites querying `[data-part="minimap"]` as proof the pane is showing, and that selector matches while it is collapsed.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

The two panes were described the wrong way round, so the width transition the document gave the outline is what the minimap does. The consequence worth naming is the selector: `[data-part="minimap"]` matches while the pane is collapsed, and the document used to offer it as proof the pane was showing.
